extraction_notes: The datasheet publishes no typical threshold-voltage table value; threshold_typ is null. The typical threshold-versus-temperature curve is not a room-temperature typical scalar specification.
The second RDS(ON) row is specified at TJ = 125 degC, not 25 degC; both published typical and maximum values are preserved.
Zero-gate drain current IDSS is maximum 1 uA at VDS = 60 V, VGS = 0 V, TC = 25 degC; the 125 degC maximum is 500 uA, p. 2.
No body-diode forward-voltage or reverse-recovery specification is published.

No ID-versus-VGS transfer characteristic figure is published. Fig. 1 is an output/on-region family; Fig. 5 provides typical Ciss, Coss, and Crss traces. Curve points are manual reads from those figures.

The public PDF table lists typical Ciss = 22 pF, Coss = 11 pF, and Crss = 2.0 pF, equivalent to 2.2e-11 F, 1.1e-11 F, and 2e-12 F; its maximum-column values are 50 pF, 25 pF, and 5.0 pF, respectively. The catalog values 50 pF, 25 pF, and 5 pF therefore match the PDF maximum column rather than the extracted typical values; no PDF/catalog discrepancy remains after preserving the source column semantics. Fig. 5 uses linear VDS and linear C (pF) axes; its manually read capacitance points are converted to SI F in this JSON.
omission_reason: No body-diode specification and no transfer-characteristic figure are published. The available output and capacitance figures were extracted as manual typical curve points.
